scientific_integrity: Finite enumeration was independently checked through eight vertices using exact fractions and an analytic all-parameter proof. No claim of independent validation or formal certification is made.
scientific_limitations: All claims concern Bernoulli bond retention with fixed 0<p<1 on uniform recursive trees and one marked nonroot vertex. It is an exact two-point probability/conditional first-moment law, not an assertion about higher-order independence or an arbitrary preferential-attachment model. Publication-priority verification beyond inspected primary texts remains open, especially for general reinforced-urn theorems.
title: Age-monotone, lag-free Palm amplification in recursive-tree percolation
